rule: No partial, inferred, repaired, or convenience-parser evidence may satisfy a required closure condition.

conditions.condition: Any required receipt, artifact, raw, normalized, join, coverage, PCAP, or cleanup field is missing, malformed, duplicated where uniqueness is required, or outside its declared receipt root.
Any receipt component or JSONL row has a missing or different run_id.
Any artifact hash or byte count mismatches, the PCAP hash source is absent, or its pcap_sha256 does not authenticate the exact PCAP bytes.
A raw serial is missing or duplicated, decoded raw bytes differ, raw SHA-256 differs, or a normalized event lacks the exact authenticated raw record.
A normalized event lacks one exact JOINED PID, start-ticks, netns-inode, and logical-host record.
A FILE_READ_OR_WRITE event lacks same-serial SYSCALL and PATH records, supported syscall, success=yes, exact audit key, exact watched path, evidence basis, requested access, or underlying syscall.
FILE_READ_OR_WRITE is absent from normalized evidence or its authenticated count is zero.
Audit loss or backlog is nonzero, unknown, non-numeric, or not explicitly reported.
Evidence collection occurs after the finite deadline, the deadline status is absent, or the collector return code is nonzero.
Post-cleanup proof is absent, its baseline is not restored, its before/after baseline hashes differ, or cleanup removes a rule not proven added by the same run.
This preparation package creates, embeds, or claims any privileged runtime result, raw audit record, normalized event, PCAP, cleanup proof, or formal experiment evidence.
The package modifies or invokes PROVX-R7R1 adapter logic in this preparation phase.
